REST Countries key

Optional. With a key, a city's panel also shows its country's capital, population, languages and currency. The key is sent only to api.restcountries.com, never to any other service.

A remembered key is stored unencrypted in this browser's local storage. Anyone with access to this browser profile, and any other page served from the same address, can read it. Leave this unticked on shared computers; the key is then forgotten when you close the tab.

No key yet? Create a free key at restcountries.com (1,000 requests a month). Answers are cached in this browser for three days.
